functions.name: osInvalDCache
functions.basis: Reviewed cache opcodes 0x15/0x11/0x01 with 16-byte lines; ROM-read caller invalidates destination.

functions.name: osInvalICache
functions.basis: Reviewed cache opcodes 0x10/0x00 with 32-byte lines; initialization invalidates exception vectors.

functions.name: osWritebackDCache
functions.basis: Reviewed cache opcode 0x19 plus full-cache 0x01 path with 16-byte lines; initialization writes exception vectors.

functions.name: osWritebackDCacheAll
functions.basis: Reviewed whole 8 KiB cache traversal with cache 0x01 and 16-byte increments.

functions.name: osEPiStartDma
functions.basis: Observed ROM wrapper calls with OSPiHandle/OSIoMesg/direction; stores handle at message+0x14, chooses read/write message type and enqueues to PI command queue.

functions.name: osContInit
functions.basis: Reviewed one-time initialization, controller query through SI read/write, controller-status decode, SI access and timer message queues.

functions.name: osInitialize
functions.basis: Reviewed CU1/FPCSR setup, PIF initialization, four exception-vector copies/cache maintenance, VI clock selection and AI register initialization; called from observed init path.

functions.name: __osExceptionPreamble
functions.basis: Reviewed 16-byte exception-vector trampoline to 0x800BA2F0; installed by osInitialize.

functions.name: __osException
functions.basis: Reviewed original kernel exception entry, thread register/FPU save, Cause dispatch, event posting and thread rescheduling; replaced by native runtime kernel.

functions.name: send_mesg
functions.basis: Reviewed exception event-table lookup and queue insertion, with return through s2 at 0x800BA920.

functions.name: handle_CpU
functions.basis: Reviewed coprocessor-unusable exception branch, checks coprocessor 1 and enables CU1 in saved thread state.

functions.name: __osEnqueueAndYield
functions.basis: Reviewed native-kernel boundary: saves running thread registers/FP state, queues thread and branches to dispatcher.

functions.name: __osEnqueueThread
functions.basis: Reviewed priority-sorted intrusive OSThread queue insertion, fields next/priority/queue.

functions.name: __osDispatchThread
functions.basis: Reviewed run-queue pop, full GPR/FPR/CP0 context restore and eret at 0x800BAC34.

functions.name: __osCleanupThread
functions.basis: Reviewed thread-return callback calling osDestroyThread(NULL), followed by padding.

functions.name: __osGetCause
functions.basis: Reviewed mfc0 v0,Cause followed by return and alignment padding.

functions.name: __osGetSR
functions.basis: Reviewed mfc0 v0,Status followed by return and alignment padding.

functions.name: __osSetFpcCsr
functions.basis: Reviewed cfc1 v0,FPCSR / ctc1 a0,FPCSR / return.

functions.name: osMapTLBRdb
functions.basis: Reviewed debug TLB slot 31 mapping at C0000000 with EntryHi restoration; called by initialization.

functions.name: osUnmapTLBAll
functions.basis: Reviewed TLB invalidation loop over indices 30 down to 0, preserving/restoring EntryHi; called by initialization.

functions.name: osAiGetLength
functions.basis: Four instructions read AI_LEN_REG at 0xA4500004 and return; observed native boot fault in audio thread at this load.

functions.name: osViGetNextFramebuffer
functions.basis: Disables interrupts, reads the framebuffer field +4 from __osViNext at 0x800CEF84, restores interrupts and returns; 8 trailing zero alignment bytes.
